clause: NYC Local Law 144 of 2021 (bias audit); section 2
obligation: Employers using automated employment decision tools must have a bias audit performed before use.
caveat: Hiring law, not lending: our deliberate out-of-scope example. The law text says 'disparate impact'; the impact-ratio detail is in the city's separate rules, which we do not hold. Enforcement began 5 July 2023.
